text.p: These are the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs joint meeting of Revolutionary Commmand Council and leaders of the ruling Baath party.
- Saddam tells endowments and religious affairs ministry to resume sending Iraqis to haj in Mecca this year.
- Greek charity group sends medicine to Iraq.
- Minister of health opens pharmaceutical exhibition held by Korean companies in Baghdad.
- Editorial attacks Rolf Ekeus and accuses him of politicising his mandate in Iraq.
- Commentary lashes out at Iran for meddling in Iraq's affairs.
- Commentary backs government in Egypt in its battle against Moslem fundamentalists.
- Engineers from the Military Industrialisation Commission manufacture 47,000 spare parts for agricultural machines.
- Article calls for greater competition in industrial sector.
